title: Setup: run HikariCP's landed PostgresTest at both #2346 revisions and transplanted onto the parent
description: Setup for case M11 (HikariCP #2346, schema reset between borrowers) of llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief.md, no claims. In the setup worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links/worktrees (M11-HikariCP-fix = b81bbc9d, M11-HikariCP-parent = ee5328d2), runs Maven offline on JDK 17 against the cache's local repository: the whole PostgresTest class (Testcontainers 1.20.3, image postgres:16 already pulled, one container per test) on the fix, the parent's own copy on the parent, and the fix's PostgresTest plus its postgres_init_script.sql transplanted onto the parent, where only testSchema should fail (the setup saw it fail alone at line 162, expected:<test> but was:<null>). Testcontainers needs -Dapi.version=1.44 for Docker 29 (passed through the POM's sureFireOptions11 property; no upstream file changed). JUnit summaries go to .../logs; worktrees are restored and build trees removed. Results go into llm-dlc/loops/organic-java-merged-pr-links-brief-setup.md.
expected: every step exits 0: fix 7/7 pass, parent's own 6/6 pass, transplant fails exactly testSchema; no containers left

steps.name: M11-HikariCP-fix: the whole landed PostgresTest (7 tests) on the fix, offline
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; source $HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/merged-pr-links/scripts/env.sh; mkdir -p $O/tmp $O/logs; export JAVA_HOME=$J17 MAVEN_OPTS=-Xmx1g; docker image inspect postgres:16 --format '{{json .RepoDigests}}'; cd $W/M11-HikariCP-fix; echo worktree=M11-HikariCP-fix commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD); git status --short; rm -rf target; trap 'rm -rf target' EXIT; set +e; $MVN -o -Dmaven.javadoc.skip -Dgpg.skip test -Dtest=PostgresTest -DforkCount=1 -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false '-DsureFireOptions11=--add-modules=ALL-MODULE-PATH -Dapi.version=1.44' > $O/logs/M11-fix-PostgresTest.maven.log 2>&1; rc=$?; set -e; echo maven-exit=$rc; python3 -I $O/scripts/junit_summary.py target/surefire-reports | tee $O/logs/M11-fix-PostgresTest.junit.txt; test $(grep -o 'tests=[0-9]*' $O/logs/M11-fix-PostgresTest.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -gt 0; test $(grep -o 'failures=[0-9]*' $O/logs/M11-fix-PostgresTest.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; test $(grep -o 'errors=[0-9]*' $O/logs/M11-fix-PostgresTest.junit.txt | cut -d= -f2) -eq 0; sleep 15; docker ps --format '{{.Image}} {{.Names}}' | grep -E 'postgres:16|ryuk' && echo 'containers still running' || echo 'no test containers left'
